rationale: DD has gapped up 6.12% on 4.69x relative volume with no news catalyst identified, making the move difficult to contextualize directionally. Price is at 82.6% of today's range and well above VWAP ($149.49) and 9-EMA ($150.68), suggesting the gap-and-run momentum may be extended, but the wide bid-ask spread (37.3 bps) and lack of a clear news driver increase adverse-selection risk.
